AssertContainsColor.description: Checks if image contains pixels of a specific color (useful for openpose, segmentation)

AssertEqual.description: Checks if two inputs are equal, throws error if not

AssertExecuted.description: Pass-through node that verifies execution occurred (not cached)

AssertImageMatch.description: Compare image against perceptual hash and fail if difference exceeds threshold

AssertInRange.description: Checks if all tensor values are within min/max bounds

AssertMaskBinary.description: Check that all mask values are exactly 0 or 1 (hard mask)

AssertMaskCoverage.description: Check that mask coverage (% of non-zero pixels) is within an expected range

AssertMaskFuzzy.description: Check that a soft-edge mask has a controlled amount of grey boundary pixels

AssertNotEqual.description: Checks if two inputs are not equal, throws error if they are equal

AssertStringContains.description: Check that a string contains an expected substring

AssertStringLength.description: Check that a string's length is within min/max bounds

AssertStringMatch.description: Check that a string matches a pattern (exact or regex)

AssertStringNotContains.description: Check that a string does NOT contain a forbidden pattern (literal, regex, or built-in LLM guard)

AssertTensorShape.description: Checks if tensor has expected dimensions. Supports 3D [B,H,W] masks and 4D [B,H,W,C] images. Use -1 to accept any value, or set channels=-1 for 3D tensors.

TestDefinition.description: Define test metadata: name, GPU requirements, and extra execution time

TestImageGenerator.description: Generate test images: solid colors, noise, face, synthetic benchmark pattern, or video benchmark pattern

TestMaskGenerator.description: Generate test masks: solid, circle, gradient, checkerboard, noise, or half masks
